Questions, answered straight

Do I need to register a 249 g drone?

The Lito 1 sits in the C0 class at about 249 g, which keeps requirements light in many regions — but rules differ by country and change over time. Check your local aviation authority before your first flight.

Does it record without a memory card?

No. Unlike some bigger DJI models, the Lito 1 has no internal storage. You need a microSD card to save photos and video, and one is not included in the box — budget for it alongside the £299.

How far does the video link really reach?

The headline 15 km figure is measured under FCC rules. In CE regions — including Europe and Nigeria — the limit is 8 km. Either way, you should always fly within visual line of sight.

Can I use the 52-minute Plus battery?

Not on the Lito 1 in the EU/UK — the Plus battery isn't supported there for this model. The standard battery's up to 36 minutes is the figure to plan around.
